Saudi Arabia Executes Bangladeshi Couple for Acts in Mecca Mosque

Saudi authorities executed a Bangladeshi couple in Mecca on Wednesday after they were convicted of committing 'immoral acts' inside a mosque. The couple had been arrested for the alleged acts, and a court sentenced them to death under 'Tazir' law. Bangladesh was reportedly kept in the dark about the execution.
